claims.head: Carolina’s shot volume meets a soft spot
claims.body: Carolina ranks 3rd of 32 for shot volume (65.8 shot attempts per 60 at 5-on-5); Philadelphia ranks 30th for shot suppression.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 5 and 5 games this season

check.measure: 5-on-5 shot attempts per 60, adjusted for score and venue
check.rule: held if tonight's figure is at or above the team's usual level; partly if between the league average and that level; otherwise didn't happen

claims.head: Philadelphia pounces on mistakes, and Carolina makes them
claims.body: Philadelphia ranks 7th of 32 for chances off turnovers (7.7% of its chances come right after winning the puck); Carolina ranks 24th for avoiding breakdowns.

check.measure: share of 5-on-5 expected goals within 5 seconds of winning the puck

claims.head: Two of the league’s heaviest-hitting teams
claims.body: Carolina’s hit score is 116 (5th of 32) and Philadelphia’s is 111 (8th). 100 is league average, after adjusting for each arena’s scorer.
claims.cite: Style fingerprint · this season blended with last · 5 and 5 games this season

check.measure: hits per 60 in close games, both teams, as a score against league average (arena-adjusted)
check.rule: held if tonight's combined hit score is at or above the two teams' average; partly if above 100; otherwise didn't happen

notes.text: S. Jarvis has not played this season. W. Carrier is in his usual spot beside S. Aho and A. Svechnikov, up from fourth-line minutes last season. That line is getting 9:15 a game at 5-on-5, down from 10:44 with Jarvis. J. Kotkaniemi has moved into Carrier’s old spot beside M. Jankowski and E. Robinson.
L. Stankoven has started killing penalties: on the ice for 30% of the team’s shorthanded time in 5 games, up from 1% last season.

faceoff.text: J. Staal is sent out to take power-play faceoffs, then changes. He has taken 68% of the team’s power-play draws but stays on for about 20 seconds at a time, against 61 for the regulars, and is most often replaced by N. Ehlers (15 of 18 changes).
